subject: Temporary onshore shielding request & TIA scoping for APAC pilot
messages:
From: Anna Kim <anna.kim@apachealth.co>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@apachealth.co
Date: 2028-05-23T09:05:00Z
Subject: Temporary onshore shielding request while UK/EEA paperwork completes

Hi Mateo —

Thanks again for last week's demo. Procurement here needs a short-term technical commitment to keep data residency inside APAC for a narrowly scoped pilot while our legal team completes the UK Addendum/TIA review.

High-level asks:
- A documented temporary onshore routing (edge fallback) for tokenized transcripts and telemetry for the pilot cohort (~2k users).
- A brief list of evidence we can attach to our procurement packet (logging/audit, retention defaults, subprocessor list).
- Estimated lead time and any cost delta for the temporary routing.

Can you and your compliance lead share a proposed configuration and an exportable evidence bundle by EOD tomorrow? Our internal procurement window is tight — we want to sign off on operations start the week after next.

Attached: APAC procurement checklist (for reference).

Thanks,
Anna Kim
Procurement Lead — APAC Health Systems
anna.kim@apachealth.co

Attachments: apac-procurement-questions.docx (docx, 48KB)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Anna Kim <anna.kim@apachealth.co>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-23T12:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Temporary onshore shielding request while UK/EEA paperwork completes

Anna —

Appreciate the clear asks. We can support a temporary APAC-only routing for the pilot as an operational configuration while legal completes the TIA/UK Addendum work. Summary below and attached proposal.

What we're proposing (short):
- Edge routing: inbound requests from APAC routed to an APAC edge region with data plane pinned to APAC-hosted GPUs; we will enable prefix KV caching to reduce cross-region calls.
- Short-term onshore fallback: if APAC capacity is constrained, requests will queue and return a 429 rather than route outbound. No automatic fallback to EU/US for pilot.
- Audit & evidence: we will provide a packet with subprocessor CSV, audit-log samples (redacted), retention policies, and 3rd-party attestation snapshots.
- Timeline & cost: configuration and evidence packet ready in 48 hours; operational change carries a 6% premium on the reserved instance hourly for the pilot window (est. 3 weeks).

Attachments: redwood-temp-routing-proposal.pdf (pdf, 72KB), tia-scope.csv (csv, 9KB) — the CSV lists the TIA elements we suggest you validate with legal.

Next steps I propose:
1) Kimberly (cc) to confirm the evidence checklist and include any missing technical attestations.
2) Laura to confirm procurement pricing and generate an amended SOW.
3) Anna to confirm acceptance of the routing constraint and the small premium.

If that works, I'll kick off the configuration and a short runbook for your engineering lead.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks — quick compliance notes and evidence plan:

Compliance notes:
- We will include a subprocessor snapshot (CSV) with versioning and access scopes. That will contain the APAC edge provider, monitoring, and key-management provider.
- For audit logs: we'll provide a 72-hour redacted sample (token and user hashes masked) showing ingress/egress and host-region tags.
- Retention: default retention remains 30 days for pilot telemetry; we can shorten to 7 days on request for this pilot and document the change in the SOW.
- SCCs/UK IDTA: the legal review on your side will need the TIA mappings; mateo attached a CSV with suggested mappings. If your counsel requests a UK Addendum clause timeline, we typically map the legal review to a 4–6 week cadence.

Open evidence gaps (please confirm):
- Do you require HSM/KMS attestation for the APAC key store? (we have KMS integration notes if needed).
- Will you need a SOC2 snapshot as part of procurement? We can provide the 2027 Type II cert and the SOC2 coverage matrix.

I'll produce a single compressed packet (PDF + CSV + MD readme) and upload to the shared drive link Mateo included. Expect that in ~36 hours.

Kimberly Park
Privacy & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
